summary: Add an event-driven Notification Watchlist backed by notification-only automation rules.
features: Create armed notification watches from explicit natural-language chat requests.
Monitor Home Assistant state transitions with optional time windows, expiry, cooldown, and one-shot behavior.
Surface notification rules in a focused Watchlist while preserving Automation Library as the source of truth.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Identify Telegram notification entities from Home Assistant registry metadata instead of display-name guessing.
Respect Notification Center quiet hours and critical overrides during automatic watch delivery.
Avoid firing watches immediately on startup by requiring a real state transition.
Preserve v0.12.43 credential boundaries, diagnostics, delivery history, and backup behavior.
validation: Home Assistant entity-registry Telegram classification coverage
